question: As of October 2024, who is the secretary of the Department of Atomic Energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Ajit Kumar Mohanty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. Ajit Kumar Mohanty is the Secretary of the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) in India as of October 2024.
 
• He also serves as the Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission, which is responsible for formulating policies for the development of nuclear energy in India.
 
• Dr. Mohanty is an accomplished physicist with expertise in nuclear physics, particularly in high-energy nuclear reactions and quantum mechanics.
 
• He previously served as the Director of the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), India’s premier nuclear research facility.
 
• Under his leadership, the DAE focuses on advancing India's nuclear energy program and promoting research in various nuclear and allied sciences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Roshan Basu**

 
 
• There is no credible information linking Dr. Roshan Basu to the position of Secretary of the Department of Atomic Energy or any related role in India’s nuclear sector.
 
• This option is likely fictitious or unrelated to the current context of the question.
 
 
 
• **Ramesh Chauhan**
 
 
• Ramesh Chauhan is a well-known Indian industrialist and chairman of Bisleri International, a leading packaged water company.
 
• He is not associated with the Department of Atomic Energy or India’s nuclear program.
 
 
 
• **Rakesh Sinha**
 
 
• Rakesh Sinha is a public intellectual and a Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha, representing the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He has no professional connection to the field of atomic energy or the Department of Atomic Energy.
 
 
 
• **Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)**
 
 
• The DAE is responsible for India’s nuclear energy production, research, and development.
 
• It was established in 1954 under the guidance of Dr. Homi J. Bhabha, the father of India’s nuclear program.
 
• The DAE oversees premier organizations like Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL), and Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR).
 
• The department operates under the direct charge of the Prime Minister of India.
